meta.name: api-design-principles
meta.description: Master REST and GraphQL API design principles to build intuitive, scalable, and maintainable APIs that delight developers. Use when designing new APIs, reviewing API specifications, or establishing API design standards.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在设计或评审 API 接口,需要一套最佳实践。
copy.tagline_en: Design intuitive, scalable REST and GraphQL APIs using proven principles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing new APIs or setting API design standards.

howto.what: Claude 会按 REST 与 GraphQL 的设计原则帮你设计、评审 API,产出资源命名、HTTP 方法语义、版本策略、分页与错误格式等方面的建议。
howto.when: 当你设计新的 REST 或 GraphQL API、评审 API 规范,或为团队制定 API 设计标准时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一套用户和订单的 REST API,给出资源和路由

howto.what_en: Claude applies REST and GraphQL design principles to help you design or review an API, covering resource naming, HTTP method semantics, versioning, pagination and error formats.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you design a new REST or GraphQL API, review an API spec, or set API design standards for a team.

say_en.text: Design a REST API for users and orders, with resources and routes
say_en.note: Gives naming and HTTP method suggestions
